name: Quick Response and Community Grants (Regenerative Environment)
summary: Auckland and Northland community funder whose Regenerative Environment focus area backs conservation and restoration of the environment, with priority for projects led by tangata whenua. Quick Response grants go up to NZD 25,000 and Community Grants cover larger requests.

status.quote: We have two funding pathways that are open all year, and that you can apply for online at any time
